# Visitor screening policy

## Key steps

- Screen every visitor no later than 48 hours after arrival.

## Policy

Visitors must be screened by front-desk staff before they enter a patient room.
Staff should notify the charge nurse promptly and/or record the result.
The charge nurse must review each record within 3 days.
Screening cut infection rates by 92% (Smith 2024, Journal of Visitor Safety).
Front-desk coverage runs 3 shifts of 8 hours, for a total of 20 hours each day.
Give 10 U of the vaccine Q.D. to each visitor who asks.
Screen every visitor no later than 24 hours after arrival.
